// What We Do

Caring for your valves
across their service life

OSA is more than a distributor — we're a service partner that helps extend the working life of your valves and actuators. Our team inspects, disassembles, repairs and tests to manufacturer standards, issuing a full report and certificate every time.

  • Engineers and technicians trained by the brand owners
  • A workshop fully equipped with pressure-testing tools
  • Genuine spare parts and inspection certificates on every job
Request a Service Quote
// Our Capabilities

Our Services

Covering every stage of valve and actuator service, under international safety and quality standards.

Valve Repair & Overhaul

Valve repair & overhaul
Disassembly, cleaning, replacement of worn parts and reassembly to manufacturer specifications — for every valve type and brand.

Actuator Service

Actuator maintenance
Inspection and repair of both pneumatic and electric actuators, including control units and positioners.

Pressure Testing & Certification

Pressure testing & certification
Leak and pressure tests (hydrostatic / seat test) with reports and certificates issued to international standards.

Inspection & PM

Scheduled inspection & maintenance
Planning and carrying out preventive maintenance — condition checks, measurements and a maintenance history for each valve.

On-site Service

On-site service
A mobile team equipped to repair, replace or inspect valves right at your site to reduce downtime.

Genuine Spare Parts

Genuine spare parts supply
Supply of O-rings, seal kits, internals and genuine spare parts from the brand owners for assured quality and longevity.

// How It Works

Our Service Process

A transparent, traceable process from intake all the way to delivery.

1

Intake & Assessment

Receive the valve and job details, then assess initial condition and repair scope.

2

Disassembly & Inspection

Disassemble, clean and measure components against standard values.

3

Repair & Overhaul

Replace worn parts, recondition, and reassemble using genuine spare parts.

4

Testing & Certification

Pressure and leak testing, with reports and certificates provided.

5

Delivery

Return the valve with full documentation and ongoing maintenance recommendations.

Ready to get your valves back to full performance?
